status: training-only observed-road plane approximation; middle-west interpolation and beyond-hull extrapolation remain unvalidated

spatial_support.meaning: Conditional cluster-bootstrap uncertainty of one plane, not physical ground accuracy; nearest point distance exposes gaps

limitations: Map units inherit training GPS registration; fitted map camera height is not a new physical measurement.
No uniform rescale, local warp, Gaussian expected-depth fitting, or held-out calibration.
Three-view tracks use a 1.21 m horizontal-plane match-search initializer, then unconstrained triangulation with frozen training camera poses.
Repeated features and camera errors can correlate road tracks; bootstrap only measures conditional plane stability.
